HEAD: curl --head 'https://api.test/ping'
multipart fields and files:
# multipart file content is read from local file(s): a b.txt
curl -X POST 'https://api.test/upload' \
  --form-string 'title=hello world' \
  --form-string 'secret=***' \
  -F 'file=@"a b.txt";type=text/plain'
binary body:
# binary request body (4 bytes) is not included; save it as request-body.bin before replaying
curl -X POST 'https://api.test/blob' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' \
  --data-binary '@request-body.bin'
binary body with content type:
# binary request body (2 bytes) is not included; save it as request-body.bin before replaying
curl -X PUT 'https://api.test/blob' \
  -H 'content-type: image/png' \
  --data-binary '@request-body.bin'
truncated body:
# request body truncated to maxBodyLength (12 of 37 chars); the replayed body is incomplete
curl -X POST 'https://api.test/x' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"text":"abc'
truncated form:
# request body truncated to maxBodyLength (4 of 10 chars); the replayed body is incomplete
curl -X POST 'https://api.test/x' \
  --data-urlencode 'a=abcd' \
  --data-urlencode 'b=z'
redirected PUT without hops:
# the request was redirected; PUT is not followed with -L because curl would not apply Playwright's redirect rules. Send the redirect target yourself
curl -X PUT 'https://api.test/old' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"a":1}'
redirect chain:
# the request was redirected 2 time(s). Playwright's redirect rules cannot be replayed by a single curl, so there is one command per step
# (cookies for the later steps come from the cookie jar and are not included)
# step 1 of 3 (response: 303)
curl -X POST 'https://a.test/start' \
  -H 'Authorization: ***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Cookie: ***' \
  --data-raw '{"a":1}'
# step 2 of 3 (response: 302)
curl 'https://b.test/next' \
  -H 'Authorization: ***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Cookie: ***'
# step 3 of 3 (response: 200)
curl 'https://b.test/final' \
  -H 'Authorization: ***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Cookie: ***'
invalid URL: # could not build curl: invalid URL
hostile values:
